name: github/blame complete route (CHAOS-3335 + CHAOS-3343)
$limitation: The plan targets each implemented correctness class independently: complete-inventory foundation capping, resumable persisted selection, retryable provider errors, timestamp precision, live-Python normalization and selection parity, complete readback comparison, FINAL tenant-scoped lookup, and production construction. The independent route switch remains default-off. The PostgreSQL plus ClickHouse crash window is exercised as an integration gate but is not mutated here because the effect-committer and ledger guards are shared foundation covered by their owning plans.

mutations.rationale: a repository exceeding the bounded complete unit must fail before any partial blame inventory can be written or its watermark advanced
a GraphQL application error is a broken provider fetch, not a legitimate empty blame result, and must keep the unit retryable
last_synced must be stabilized to ClickHouse DateTime64(3) precision so exact crash readback does not classify the persisted row as divergent
the Go row constructor must preserve the active Python producer's Unknown author-name fallback rather than silently emitting an empty author
a persisted author_name mismatch at the expected version must report EffectConflict instead of letting crash recovery mark a divergent row committed

mutations.find: WHERE org_id = ? AND repo_id = ? AND path = ? AND line_no = ?
mutations.replace: WHERE org_id != ? AND repo_id = ? AND path = ? AND line_no = ?
mutations.rationale: readback must reconcile only the owning tenant's natural key; selecting another tenant's colliding row must never classify the local effect exact
readback must resolve the winning ReplacingMergeTree version; reading physical versions makes exact recovery ambiguous after an older row exists
each successful bounded sync must exclude paths already durable for the owning tenant or every retry will burn quota on the same prefix
a colliding repository UUID under another tenant must never suppress the owning tenant's unblamed path
the production binary must construct the durable coverage reader with the same live lease as the blame effect sink
the progress read must fail closed when persisted coverage exceeds its explicit memory bound instead of loading an unbounded repository inventory into the worker
